messages:
tara: Low-energy weeknight recs thread. Want either one long gentle movie or a short story collection + background album for weekend reading. Vote with emoji and drop 1-line sell. Not work stuff, promise. 

mike: Movie: Paterson (quiet, small moments) + Album: Sufjan Stevens - Seven Swans or Carrie & Lowell. Perfect for slow watching. 

jing: Book: Ted Chiang's "Exhalation" (short stories, dense but quick) + Album: Harold Budd ambient piano for reading focus.

paul: Movie double-feature: anything Wes Anderson (moodboard) + Album: Randy Newman soundtrack stuff. silly and precise.

sofia: Book: The Ocean at the End of the Lane (magical, soft-weird) + Album: Sigur Rós for that swell-y atmosphere.

tara: Emoji poll: 
  🟩 = Paterson + Sufjan
  🟦 = Exhalation + Harold Budd
  🟨 = Wes Anderson + Randy Newman
  🔴 = Ocean at the End + Sigur Rós

shelf-bot: Created tiny playlists/compilations for each option: https://open.spotify.fake/paterson, https://open.spotify.fake/exhalation, https://open.spotify.fake/anderson, https://open.spotify.fake/ocean (auto-generated)

mike: 🟩 from me. small domestic rhythms are my jam.

jing: 🟦 for me. short stories + soft piano = focus lane.

paul: 🟨. symmetry and set design vibes. also GIF: (Anderson montage)

sofia: 🔴 for the swell. oceanic feelings.

tara: Tally so far: Paterson 1, Exhalation 1, Anderson 1, Ocean 1. tie! Quick tie-breaker: recommend a single track to loop for your pick.

mike: "Living Room" (Sufjan gentle strum)

jing: "Balthus" (Harold Budd short piano piece)

paul: "The Moon" (Randy Newman short interlude)

sofia: "Svefn-g-englar" (Sigur Rós long swell)

tara: Going with Exhalation + Harold Budd for tonight's quiet reading hour. I'll loop the Budd track between stories. If anyone wants the playlist link DM me. :headphones:

paul: Also spontaneous tea & biscotti in kitchen at 20:00 for the reading hour. bring a thing if you want.
shelf-bot: Reminder posted: kitchen meetup 20:00 (auto-message).

jing: bringing a weird annotated bookmark someone gave me. small literary show-and-tell?

mike: I'll bring biscotti and bad jokes.

tara: Perfect. See you in the kitchen, tiny book swap/rec exchange optional. :book:
